headline: Surveillance firm Flock cuts jobs amid privacy backlash
summary: Flock Safety is cutting staff as privacy concerns grow over its AI-powered surveillance cameras and license-plate readers. Sources say the company plans to shed about 18% of its workforce, and it would not say whether CEO Garrett Langley would also take a pay cut.

claims.statement: Flock Safety is cutting staff amid a privacy backlash against its AI-powered surveillance cameras and license-plate readers.

claims.statement: The cuts amount to about 18% of Flock's workforce, according to people with direct knowledge of the plans.
